chunks: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. al-Hasan b. Aban narrated to us from al-Husayn b. Sa'id from Muhammad b. al-Husayn al-Kinani from his grandfather from Abi 'Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him). He said:

Verily, God the Mighty and Majestic sent a book unto His Prophet (S) before death came to him and said: 'O Muhammad! This book is your will to the nobleman of your family.' So he said: 'Who is the nobleman of my family, O Gabriel?' He said: "'Ali b. Abi Talib."

On the book were seals of gold. So the Prophet (S) gave it to 'Ali (AS) and ordered him to open one seal and act upon it. So he opened a seal and acted. Then he gave it to his son al-Hasan (AS), who opened a seal and acted. Then he gave it to al-Husayn (AS), who opened a seal and found: 'Go out with a people toward martyrdom, for they will not find martyrdom except with you. Ransom yourself for God the Mighty and Majestic.' So he did so.

Then he gave it to 'Ali b. al-Husayn (AS), who opened a seal and found: 'Be silent, stick to your house, and worship your Lord until certainty comes.' Then he gave it to Muhammad b. 'Ali (AS), who found: 'Narrate and give edicts. Fear none but God.' Then he gave it to me, and I found: 'Narrate, give edicts, spread the knowledge of your Ahl al-Bayt, affirm your righteous forefathers. Fear none but God, and you are in protection and safety.' Then I will give it to Musa b. Ja'far, and likewise until the rise of the Mahdi (AS).

key_terms.الشهادة: Martyrdom -- referring to Imam al-Husayn's mission at Karbala
key_terms.المهدي: The Mahdi -- the awaited twelfth Imam who will establish justice
key_terms.النجيب: The nobleman -- the most distinguished person of the Prophet's family, identified as 'Ali b. Abi Talib
key_terms.اليقين: Certainty -- a Quranic euphemism for death (cf. 15:99), used in Imam Zayn al-'Abidin's instructions
key_terms.خواتيم من ذهب: Seals of gold -- each seal contained divinely mandated instructions for a specific Imam

ai.seo_question: What did the sealed book with golden seals contain for each of the Twelve Imams according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates that God sent a sealed book to the Prophet Muhammad (S) before his death, identifying it as his will to the nobleman of his family. Gabriel specified that the nobleman was 'Ali b. Abi Talib. The book bore gold seals, each containing specific instructions for successive Imams. 'Ali opened the first seal and acted upon it, then passed it to al-Hasan who did likewise. Al-Husayn's seal instructed him to lead his people to martyrdom and to sacrifice himself for God -- which he fulfilled at Karbala. 'Ali b. al-Husayn (Zayn al-'Abidin) was told to be silent, stay home, and worship until death. Muhammad al-Baqir was told to narrate and give edicts fearlessly. Imam al-Sadiq himself found instructions to narrate, give edicts, spread the knowledge of Ahl al-Bayt, and affirm his righteous forefathers. He would then pass it to Musa b. Ja'far, continuing through each Imam until the rise of the Mahdi.
